notes.title: Playtest Update v0.13.5 - Now Ongoing
notes.content: [p]Commanders,[/p][p][/p][p]A huge thank you to everyone who has jumped into the playtest. Your participation and feedback have been incredibly valuable.[/p][p]After meeting so many of you and hearing your thoughts at events like BitSummit and ChinaJoy, we realized that closing access to the playtest would feel like cutting a great conversation short. So we've decided that:[/p][p][/p][h3]The playtest is now ongoing, with no scheduled end date![/h3][p][/p][p]To support this extended mission, we'll be rolling out regular updates. Today's patch (v0.13.5) introduces a new officer for Exploration Mode, along with some new narrative content to uncover:[/p][p][/p][p][b]New Officer MAKAILA: [/b]Once destined to be the light of her civilization, a tragic accident caused her to cast it into shadow. She can inspire allies with a warm glow or unleash scorching flame upon her enemies.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45643981/3d8bd3c6b0c2bd1b9745bd728c03fcdf6ff7735f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]New Story Content:[/b] Discover more of the world through the reworked exploration mission.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45643981/1a933a17bf3352cadafa124eeaeef8e94daf56c2.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]General Improvements:[/b] A batch of quality-of-life optimizations and experimental sound effects have been added to improve the overall experience.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45643981/ed7cad784d52fc3538fe1085499fbdd5562ab8c5.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]Patch Notes[/h2][p][/p][h3]Content[/h3][list][*][p]New Officer: MAKAILA is now available as a starting officer in Exploration Mode.[/p][/*][*][p]New Narrative: Added new exploration plotlines and branching events with unique dialogues for each Officer.[/p][/*][*][p]Gameplay Change: To ensure tactical integrity, character modification (leveling up, equipping echoes, resetting levels) is now restricted in the combat phase.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]UI / UX[/h3][list][*][p]Camera: You can now pan the camera by moving your cursor to the edge of the screen. A boundary has been added to prevent the camera from moving too far into unexplored darkness.[/p][/*][*][p]Ability Clarity:[/p][list][*][p]Available Duality Swap abilities will now have a glow.[/p][/*][*][p]Abilities on cooldown are now covered with a grey mask.[/p][/*][*][p]Zone object buttons now have a pulse indicator for better visibility.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Status Indicators: Operatives with remaining movement or attack actions are now highlighted on their health plate.[/p][/*][*][p]Combat Flow:[/p][list][*][p]Added a "Skip Confirmation" option for ending your turn, for faster play.[/p][/*][*][p]Damage prediction is now more accurate, accounting for more triggered effects like damage redirection.[/p][/*][*][p]The "Retreat" button is now correctly disabled during the enemy's turn.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]General: Added an option to lock the mouse to the game window (hold ALT to temporarily unlock).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Visuals[/h3][list][*][p]Animations: Officers now play deployment animation when entering the battlefield.[/p][/*][*][p]UI: Iterated the panel for Duality Swap abilities and improved the tooltip layout for tile effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Effects: Updated the outline effect on units and objects to be crisper and more defined.[/p][/*][*][p]Environment: Decorations will now become semi-transparent when a unit is standing on their tile or when hovered over, improving battlefield clarity.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Audio[/h3][list][*][p]Experimental SFX: Added the first implementation of sound effects for various gameplay actions and UI interactions. This feature can be enabled in the settings menu.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Performance[/h3][list][*][p]Optimized performance to improve average FPS across most scenes.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the frequency of frame spikes during gameplay.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where dialogue could get stuck if the player held CTRL to speed it up.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug causing dialogue text animations to be delayed at incorrect positions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the Protection Totem could incorrectly grant damage immunity to units not adjacent to it.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where tile trigger effects were not being saved correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash that could occur when exiting to the main menu under certain conditions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where damage from the "Surround Consume" mechanic was being incorrectly reduced by Defense.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Other[/h3][list][*][p]Updated the credits roll.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated some area and unit names to align with the latest story developments.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]Share your thoughts[/h2][p][/p][p]Your feedback is the compass that guides our development. Please continue to share your thoughts![/p][list][*][p]Press [b]F2[/b] in-game to report a bug or share a suggestion[/p][/*][*][p]Fill out the survey after completing each mode (it's also available from the main menu)[/p][/*][*][p]Join our [url="https://discord.gg/fuHadQuAeM"]Discord[/url] to chat directly with the dev team[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]If you're enjoying this journey, please consider adding [i]Paraside: Duality Unbound[/i] to your [b]Steam Wishlist[/b]. For a small team like ours, that single click makes a huge difference.[/p][p]Thank you for being with us.[/p][p][/p][p]— Paraside Dev Team[/p]

notes.title: Playtest Update v0.13.4
notes.content: [p]Hey Commanders,[/p][p][/p][p]Build v0.13.4 is now live! Thank you to everyone who's been testing and sending feedback. This update focuses on common issues, bug fixes, and a few quality-of-life tweaks. Refresh Steam to grab the patch and let us know how it feels ːhappy_seagullː[/p][p][/p][h2]Patch Notes[/h2][p][/p][h3]Content[/h3][list][*][p]Connected the Other Side of the south-west Polarity Post to the Capital.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]UI / UX[/h3][list][*][p]Added a level-up icon to operative buttons in the side panel and the Operatives window.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a warning pop-up when a controller is detected (as full controller support isn't ready yet).[/p][/*][*][p]Added a warning when you don't have enough Reset Tokens.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a glow to the Survey button.[/p][/*][*][p]Added access to End Turn and End Battle even while an operative is selected.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a dedicated Deselect button.[/p][/*][*][p]Clicking the currently selected operative now jumps to manual Attack instead of spending a Move.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed friendly threat zone color to yellow.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the Exchange Rune draw animation to be much faster.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the black screen animation in several places for a more natural feel.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Audio[/h3][list][*][p]Added a "whoosh" SFX when entering any mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Replaced exploration music with a calmer, more ambient track.[/p][p] [/p][/*][/list][h3]Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Corrected several typos and unified attribute keywords across the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash that could occur after opening Guardian's school-selection panel and then viewing other operatives.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash caused by additive effects during an Attack after a Turn Reset.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed officers losing experience after loading a save.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed damage numbers appearing in the wrong screen position at non-1080p resolutions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Recon Swap occasionally failing to set scene lighting.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2]What’s Next[/h2][p][/p][p]The new officer [b]MAKAILA[/b] is almost ready, and we're expanding the exploration story in the next update. If there's something you'd like us to prioritize, drop a note in the comments or on Discord.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for participating in the playtest. Cheers![/p]

notes.title: Playtest Update v0.13.3
notes.content:
Hey Commanders,

A new build is live! Refresh Steam to grab v0.13.3 and let us know if it smooths things out.

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]

[h3]Balance[/h3]
[list]
[*]Golden-Eyes Druid now casts fewer tile effects, making the fights a bit less RNG-heavy.
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Crash when using the keyboard shortcut to undeploy an Officer.
[*]Conquered places popping back during a Realm Swap.
[*]Save-load issue that could corrupt campaign progress in Exploration mode.
[/list]
[h2]What’s Next[/h2]

We'll send a proper announcement about the playtest soon. Your feedback over the last few days has been invaluable, keep it coming on Discord or through the in-game survey. 

Thanks for participating in the playtest. Cheers!
